title: Console list header: a long object description pushes the primary header action into the "…" overflow menu at desktop width
body:
Filing class: ① user-visible UI defect — reach: public door, measured in a browser (present on 18.3.0 and 18.5.0). **Reader:** `domain:ui` lane (list page header layout in the Console).

## Symptom

On a list page whose object has a long description, the object's primary header action is not drawn as a button; it is folded into the "…" overflow menu, at a 1440 px wide viewport.

objectstack-ai/hotclm, `clm_contract` list (`My Contracts`), Console in **English**: the description "A contract from intake to archive: parties, commercial and legal terms, lifecycle status and the stamps each stage leaves." fills the header row and the `Launch Contract` button is only reachable through "…" (menu: `Launch Contract`, `Add to favorites`). The same page in zh-CN, where the description is shorter, shows the `发起合同` button. Screenshots `00-req1-fresh-browser-english.png` and `01-req1-landing.png` in the hotclm 18.5 upgrade report.

## Expected

The description truncates (or wraps to its own line) before a primary action collapses into the overflow menu; the primary action stays visible at desktop widths.

## Business reason

The main thing a requester comes to the list to do (launch a contract) disappears for English readers, purely because of description length.

Dedupe: objectstack issues (all states) for `header action overflow description long` — 27 hits, none about the description crowding out the action (#27594 is the list-view switcher, #25945 a tracking card).

---
_Filed from the hotclm 18.5.0 upgrade browser regression (2026-11-15)._
